name: discord
description: Two-way chat relay between the server and one Discord channel (no dependencies: Discord gateway over Node's built-in WebSocket).
author: pooper

token.description: Discord bot token (bot needs the Message Content intent, View Channel + Send Messages in the channel)

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL of that channel: game messages then show with the player's name as the sender

skip-commands.description: Don't relay game chat starting with ! or /
